Subject: Clarification regarding your recent email

Dear [Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to seek clarification on a few points in your recent email to ensure I provide the most accurate and helpful response.

First, regarding the instruction to "name the shape with three sides," could you please clarify the context or purpose of this request? I want to make sure I understand whether this is a standalone question, part of a larger task, or if it relates to the documents you mentioned.

Second, you asked me to forward documents from our previous discussion and add my thoughts on how to proceed. To ensure my input is as relevant as possible, could you specify which particular aspects of the project or next steps you would like me to focus on? Additionally, if there are specific documents from our past discussions you are referring to, please let me know so I can locate and send the correct files.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your guidance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
